neden: GSC: 'lip balm for kids' 96 gosterim/poz 8.1, 'childrens lip balm' 48, 'kids lip balm' 25, 'lip balm kids' 17, 'cinnamon lip balm' 20 — toplam ~200 gosterim, 1 tik. Google tek bir aroma sayfasini gosteriyor; koleksiyon hic siralanmiyor.
html:
Seven natural lip balms, in flavours for adults and for children. The adult range runs from coconut and orange to cinnamon and a bergamot and lemon blend; the kids' balms come in orange, lemon and strawberry.

Every balm is the same 6g stick and the same simple idea: plant oils and butters, no synthetic fragrance, nothing you would not want on a child's lips. They are made in Türkiye under ETKO Cosmos Natural certification and sent to you from the UK.

Choosing a kids' lip balm

The children's flavours are milder and sweeter — lemon and strawberry are the two that get asked for most. They are the same formula as the adult balms, so if you are buying for the whole family there is no need to pick different products, only different flavours.

For chapped lips that have gone past dryness, the SOS Stick is the heavier option.

neden: GSC: 'natural hair serum' 34 gosterim/poz 14.6, 'kids sulfate free shampoo' 12/poz 11.6, 'kids natural shampoo' 7, 'baby shampoo without sulfate' 2 — urun sayfalari 8-16 araliginda, 0 tik.
html:
Four products, covering a wash, a detangle and a treatment. The herbal shampoo is the everyday one; the baby and kids shampoo is the same idea in a gentler formula, free from sulphates and parabens.

If brushing after bath time is a battle, the easy combing spray is made for exactly that. The hair serum is the finishing step: ten botanical oils, no silicones, so it nourishes rather than coats.

All four are 100% natural in origin and dispatched from the UK.

neden: GSC: 'baby bath temperature' 28 gosterim/poz 11.1, 'kids hand soap' 15/poz 9.1, 'incia diaper rash' 9, 'natural baby oil' 8 — en genis koleksiyon (24 urun) ve hic aciklamasi yok.
html:
Everything for a baby's day, from the bath to the changing mat. Washing starts with the baby and kids shampoo and the foaming hand soap; after the bath there is baby oil, and the diaper rash gel for when skin needs a little more.

The range reaches past the baby too — nipple cream and stretch mark products for the weeks around birth, laundry and dishwashing liquids for a household that would rather not add synthetic fragrance to everything it washes.

Sets and gifts

If you are buying for a new family rather than restocking, the bath time and new mum sets put the basics together, and the personalised towel bear is the one people tend to give as a gift.

Every formula here is 100% natural in origin, made in Türkiye under ETKO Cosmos Natural certification, and sent from the UK.

neden: GSC: 'compare mineral and chemical sun cream for sensitive skin types' 12 gosterim/poz 9.0, 'naif baby & kids mineral sunscreen spf50' 11/poz 10.1 — karsilastirma niyetli sorgular, koleksiyon sayfasi bunlar icin dogru hedef.
html:
Mineral sun protection for the whole family, in four formats: a lotion for everyone, a lighter face SPF50, a baby and child SPF50, and a stick for ears, noses and the bits that get missed.

Mineral, not chemical

These use non-nano titanium dioxide, which sits on the skin and reflects UV rather than absorbing it. That is the practical difference people are usually asking about: a mineral filter works from the moment it is on, which is why many people with sensitive skin look for a mineral filter.

They are Ecocert-certified and free from synthetic fragrance. Reapply every two hours, and more often after swimming or towelling.

html:
A short face routine: a foaming cleanser to wash with, a mineral SPF50 for the day, and a lip balm. The face sunscreen is lighter than the body lotion and sits under make-up without pilling.

The lash and brow serum is the one addition — a nightly drop, applied with the pipette.

Everything here is 100% natural in origin and free from parabens, silicones and synthetic fragrance.
